blocks.content: Reconstructed 2026-07-10 from the Hyperquiz Founding Charter (.claude/workflows/bp-hyperquiz-charter.md) and the recovered engine branch hyperquiz-p1-recovered. The original localhost:4000 paper body was unreachable at reconstruction time, so this is rebuilt from those sources and the built code — not a byte-copy of the lost original. Canonical ledger: the hyperquiz-epic task tree on guerrilla.

The recovered engine verified the cursor canvas + heatmap cloud by wiring and decoder cross-checks in node, NOT in a real browser. Closed this wave (hq-w1-live-verify): chrome-devtools against live /quiz/host|play/:pin on guerrilla — websocket 101 (not 403), cursor canvas, answer flow, Studio live-edit round-trip, honest error states.

The demo must reach guerrilla via its PHX_HOST domain (guerrilla.barkpark.cloud) or a BARKPARK_EXTRA_ORIGINS entry. A mismatched Origin makes /quiz/websocket 403 SILENTLY — the LiveView drops and the surface goes click-dead with no error. Same failure mode that killed Studio after the TLS cutover.

Individual cursors saturate the fan-out at a few hundred concurrent pointers. Mitigation is built (Decision B): the O(1) heatmap above @heatmap_threshold 300. The residual risk is the threshold being mistuned for a given room — mitigated by the runtime set_heatmap_threshold/2 setter.
Decision B targets ~2,000/room on one node. If real load on guerrilla proves a lower ceiling, hq-p7-shard (multi-node) unparks — but only on measured evidence, not speculation.

Because the socket "/quiz" line compiles unconditionally (the one irreducible core edit), a disabled quiz plugin still exposes a dormant /quiz socket path. Harmless: no channel is reachable, so there is nothing to join. Accepted tradeoff, identical to Pulse.

Decisions A/B/C were autopilot-recorded with no human sign-off, and the 45 local hq-* tasks are unpublished drafts. Mitigated by the charter ratification (human veto welcome, reversible-by-design) and by refiling a published task tree + these papers on guerrilla as the canonical ledger.
